data.narrative:
Cowboy Space Corporation, a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Baiju Bhatt, is currently valued at $2.0B post-money following $355M in total capital raised. The valuation analysis triangulates against a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning the sector.

Two valuation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the $2.0B last post-money valuation with a 1.9x typical Series B step-up multiplier, implies a forward valuation of $3.8B. Peer-median benchmarking across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Sierra Space at $8.0B Series C, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Skyryse at $1.1B Series C) yields a median valuation of $1.3B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring could not be applied due to absence of revenue disclosure, typical for private companies in this sector. The public Space & Aerospace median trades at 27.4x price-to-sales across the five tickers.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.1B to $4.4B, with a median implied value of $2.5B. This median aligns closely with the current $2.0B valuation, suggesting fair pricing at present. Primary uncertainties stem from high valuation dispersion in the peer set (driven by stage heterogeneity and differing revenue/profitability profiles) and the absence of revenue data precluding public-market anchoring.
